title: oroya peruviana var. neoperuviana
intro: Oroya peruviana var. neoperuviana, commonly known as the Neoperuvian cinchona or 'Cinchona succirubra', is a plant species native to Peru, belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and malaria, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an antimalarial agent. The therapeutic actions of Oroya peruviana var. neoperuviana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as quinine and cinchonine, which have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antimalarial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant play a crucial role in its therapeutic efficacy, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
